structural_change: QC-P5 10-23 a0 v4 (from v3; COORD A0-clock concern): CLOCK TAP GRID. v2 NK measured 1,133 ps core insertion from one ck pin (probe: 17-level TritonCTS top tree to 48 k-means roots 558 ps + 313 ps balance pads + 115 ps local trees). v4: 20 interior M7 clock tap ports ck + ck_t1..ck_t19 (RTL OT_A0_CK_TAPS, no RTL loads) at equal-sink-count centroids of the v2 placed sinks (~2.2k sinks, <= 265 um reach each; the die spine drops M8 -> M7 onto them); PRE_CTS a0_clock_taps.tcl moves every sink to its nearest tap (die_plan clock_taps.tcl @71e64b85e, cap 3000 sinks), post-CTS tap balance to 250 +/- 40 ps; no k-means top tree. GPL routability-driven mode dropped (v2 NK/NL both diverged at overflow 0.19 with +57-71% routability inflation and reverted; NK legal HPWL 7.52 m vs a0ck 3.87 m without it). Regions, outline, signal pins, RTL body, cycles = v3. QC-P4 10-23 a0 v3 (from v2): v2 initial-GRT probe left hotspot 2 hot (NK 3,417 / NL 5,268 overflow in x220-320 y700-740); dwr/der L9 writer boxes 2x taller (660.6-760.6) and the hub box moved up to y 764.6-829 plus the LSL row-0/1 gap band (y 819.7-829) W and E, so the writers spread and the hub no longer stacks on them. QC-P3 10-23 a0 v2 (from a0ck): L1 ring readers co-located with their writers (regions only; GEOM 11:44 hotspots (230,410)/(220-320,720)), GPL routability-driven. Same RTL, outline, pins, clock. QC-A0 10-23 (FALLBACK: one core clock ck, 48 k-means local roots (clock_split_km.tcl) under one TritonCTS top tree): A0 planned hard core of the Qwen compute variant-B plan (CB quad, 4 cores at (86.4|699.84, 77.76|1382.4), 457.92 x 1157.76, one spine tap per core). Same rpf floorplan, children, regions, request decoders, RTL body and cycles as qfd_tile_nl_romleaf_rpf@fce5d5cb2; the 35/39 clock-entry ports become internal nets of ck (r3 NL setup -169/-425 ps were 100% inter-entry crossings under 210 ps inter-entry uncertainty).
